name: 08540 · Princeton, NJ
findings: ZIP 08540 (Princeton) has 511 nonprofit organizations. 260 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 227 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08540 (Princeton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08540 (Princeton) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 227 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
